Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀 First who?
A true team player with strong analytical thinking, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is eager to learn something new every day.
Goal-oriented, highly motivated, and excited to discover new and complex topics within the payment transaction processing space.
 This role is hybrid, 5 days/MONTH from the office in Bucharest. 
 🚀 Then what?
 Senior Java Microservices Developer with a strong background in Java and Spring Boot (minimum 6 years of work experience) , building cutting-edge products for our core transactional platform, with the following tasks:
Develop new state-of-the-art Java microservices and API-based applications for the future UTA core transactional platform.
Design and improve software solutions in a scalable microservices architecture using cloud (Microsoft Azure) and containerized technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Create technical concepts, designs, and proofs-of-concept for new services.
Work closely with the Architecture, Infrastructure, and Business Intelligence teams.
Produce project-related documentation, performance tests, and functional tests.
 Required technical skills:
6+ years of software engineering experience with strong knowledge of Java, JUnit, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, JPA/Hibernate, SQL, and REST APIs.
Hands-on experience with cloud environments (Microsoft Azure) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
Proficiency with version control and build tools: Git, Maven (knowledge of JIRA and Confluence is a plus).
Solid understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins/Hudson).
Familiarity with API description languages (YAML, RAML, etc.).
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
